es: Editar un borrador para quitar redundancias, verbos vacíos y relleno, variar la longitud de las frases y anotar cada cambio.

teaching.en: First, edit your draft: cut every word that adds nothing.
teaching.es: Primero edita tu borrador: corta cada palabra que no aporta nada.
teaching.explanationEs: Edit = revisar con un objetivo; draft = la primera versión del texto.
teaching.audioText: First, edit your draft: cut every word that adds nothing.

teaching.en: Every change should make the text shorter or clearer.
teaching.es: Cada cambio debe hacer el texto más corto o más claro.
teaching.explanationEs: Change = un cambio concreto; si no mejora nada, no es un buen cambio.
teaching.audioText: Every change should make the text shorter or clearer.

teaching.en: When several short sentences follow one another, combine two of them.
teaching.es: Cuando varias frases cortas se siguen una tras otra, combina dos de ellas.
teaching.explanationEs: Combine = unir frases con una lista, and o una coma para cambiar el ritmo.
segments: When several short sentences follow one
teaching.audioText: When several short sentences follow one another, combine two of them.

teaching.en: Vary the length of your sentences: a long one, then a short one, gives rhythm.
teaching.es: Varía la longitud de tus frases: una larga y luego una corta dan ritmo.
teaching.explanationEs: Vary = alternar; length = cuántas palabras tiene una frase.
segments: Vary the length of your sentences: a long
one, then a short one, gives rhythm.
teaching.audioText: Vary the length of your sentences: a long one, then a short one, gives rhythm.

teaching.en: Repetition is fine for emphasis, but three sentences with the same opening feel flat.
teaching.es: La repetición sirve para dar énfasis, pero tres frases con el mismo comienzo suenan planas.
teaching.explanationEs: Repetition con propósito es un recurso; sin propósito, es un defecto. Opening = cómo empieza la frase.
segments: Repetition is fine for emphasis, but three
sentences with the same opening feel flat.
teaching.audioText: Repetition is fine for emphasis, but three sentences with the same opening feel flat.

teaching.en: Write a short note after each change: what you cut and why.
teaching.es: Escribe una nota corta después de cada cambio: qué cortaste y por qué.
teaching.explanationEs: Note = anotación de revisión con el patrón I changed X to Y because Z.

prompt.es: Edita el borrador: tres cambios de concisión, uno de ritmo y una nota por cambio.

answer.text:
Our school garden club meets every Saturday. Because the yard was empty, the club decided to plant a garden. Every member planted it. We planted beans, flowers and trees. Now the garden is finished. I think it is the best club in the school.
Change 1: I changed "due to the fact that" to "because" because it is shorter and keeps the meaning.
Change 2: I changed "made a decision" to "decided" because the verb is more direct.
Change 3: I changed "each and every member" to "every member" because the words repeated the same idea.
Change 4: I combined three short sentences into one because the rhythm was flat.
accepted:

Change 2: I changed "made a decision" to "decided" because the verb is more direct.

Our school garden club meets every Saturday. Since the yard was empty, the club decided to plant a garden. Every member planted it. We planted beans, flowers and trees. The garden is now finished. In my opinion, it is the best club in the school.
Change 1: I changed "due to the fact that" to "since" because it is shorter.
Change 2: I changed "made a decision" to "decided" because it is a direct verb.
Change 3: I changed "each and every member" to "every member" because it repeated an idea.
Change 4: I combined the three short sentences because the rhythm was flat.

feedback.es: Un borrador bien editado corta relleno (because), verbo directo (decided), redundancia (every member) y mejora el ritmo; cada cambio lleva una nota con razón.

origin.text: Our school garden club meets every Saturday. Due to the fact that the yard was empty, the club made a decision to plant a garden. The garden was planted by each and every member.
